title: Unlock in-game content with StoreKit and Background Assets
description: Unlock native Apple In-App Purchases for your Unity game with the new StoreKit plug-in. Reduce download sizes with the new Background Assets plug-in, which delivers language-specific asset packs so each player gets just what they need. Plus, a new Steam Asset Converter helps you migrate existing builds.

codeSnippets.title: Asset pack manifest for a localized asset pack
Convert a Steam depot to an asset pack manifest
codeSnippets.code:
# Convert a Steam depot to an asset pack manifest
xcrun ba-package convert --asset-pack-id voice-english --l en-US --on-demand voice-english.vdf -o voice-english.json

codeSnippets.title: Convert an asset pack manifest to an asset pack archive
codeSnippets.code:
# Convert an asset pack manifest to an asset pack archive
xcrun ba-package voice-english.json -o voice-english.aar
